limitations: This review is not evidence of new native qualification, training, Validation or Test completion.
Comparison concerns the Titans-MAC event adapter with common quantity/time heads, not native paper heads.
Actual runtime identity, GPU capacity and no foreign processes must pass the existing fresh native admission before deployment starts training.
The experiment tests complete adapter performance, not an isolated causal effect of sharing.
Dispatcher child exit is directly observed by its supervisor; wrapper own OS exit must not be inferred.
